v2.7.1 Update
🔇 Action Menu hover audio: Category buttons are silent on hover by default. Global and per-category hover sounds still play when explicitly configured.

announcement.title: ⚔️ Stylish Action HUD v2.7.1
announcement.content:
v2.7.1 is an audio hotfix for the Action Menu.

  • Action Menu category buttons are silent on hover by default.
  • Global and per-category hover sounds still play when explicitly configured.
